$comment: The ACoworkAgentHub browse taxonomy. This file is hub-local: the main repo has no `catalog` concept and does not need one. Categories are NOT declared in a package — they are DERIVED at index time by mapping the package's `labels` (ADR-104) onto a category via `label_categories` below. An agent's category is therefore a property of the hub's taxonomy plus the author's labels, and a label that appears in no mapping contributes to no category.

engineering.label: Engineering
engineering.description: Designs, builds, reviews or debugs software and infrastructure.

product.label: Product
product.description: Strategy, discovery, roadmaps, PRDs and launch planning.

project.label: Project
project.description: Delivery planning, coordination, estimation and progress tracking.

quality.label: Quality
quality.description: Testing, acceptance, review and quality assurance workflows.

knowledge.label: Knowledge
knowledge.description: Documents, notes, wikis, information architecture and retrieval.

research.label: Research
research.description: Investigation, literature review, competitive and market analysis.

data.label: Data
data.description: Data analysis, transformation, pipelines and reporting.

writing.label: Writing
writing.description: Drafting, editing, translation and long-form content.

devops.label: DevOps
devops.description: CI/CD, deployment, monitoring and incident response.

design.label: Design
design.description: Design systems, visual assets and design review support.

support.label: Support
support.description: Customer support, triage and service operations.

other.label: Other
other.description: Anything that does not map to a category above.

$label_categories_comment: label -> category. A package's labels are looked up here; the first label that maps wins. Labels that appear in no entry simply contribute nothing — the agent still appears under `other` if no label maps. This table is the hub's own taxonomy: the main repo neither knows nor needs it. It is maintained here so that adding a community agent never requires touching the main repo's manifest format.
$reserved_comment: These prefixes belong to the platform. The validator rejects community submissions that use them, so a community agent cannot impersonate a platform agent by id alone. The reserved list is a convention, not a signature claim — the signature establishes only `official-channel` and `not tampered`.

package_policy.max_size_note: 50 MB, matching the main repo's install-time limit.
package_policy.$forbidden_note: An agent package never carries a binary. Its capabilities are prompt, skills, builtin tools and MCP — the last one always through a stdio MCP server the user installs separately, never a binary inside the package. The main repo additionally rejects inline stdio MCP declarations for the same reason. Files under `skills/*/references/` must be inert data.
